crossRefs.note: The border extended, and turned around on the west quarter southward, from the mountain that lies before Beth Horon…
The men of Kiriath Jearim came and took Yahweh’s ark, and brought it into Abinadab’s house on the hill, and consecrated…

people.name: Ammon
people.line: An ancient nation and its capital city, enemies of Israel.

people.name: Kiriath-jearim
people.line: A city where the ark resided

translations.web: Kiriath Baal (also called Kiriath Jearim), and Rabbah; two cities with their villages.
translations.bsb: Kiriath-baal (that is, Kiriath-jearim), and Rabbah—two cities, along with their villages.
translations.kjv: Kirjathbaal, which is Kirjathjearim, and Rabbah; two cities with their villages:
translations.asv: Kiriath-baal (the same is Kiriath-jearim), and Rabbah; two cities with their villages.
